notes: Update restart can no longer stall on a hidden dialog or a lingering process
patch_notes: The update restart path had a trap: the helper started first, then a 'will now close' dialog waited for an OK click — if that dialog sat unseen, the helper waited on the app while the app waited on the click. The dialog is gone from the restart path, and the app now guarantees its own exit within seconds of an update starting. The update helper also narrates its phases on screen when run manually and caps its wait at about 30 seconds before forcing on.
